events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: From silly walks to hotel mayhem, John Cleese has given us some of the most iconic comedy moments. Which is your favourite?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed the sprawling brilliance of 'The White Album'. A double LP packed with classics – what's your go-to track?

events.title: 35 years since we lost Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman and rock icon, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly inimitable.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: A masterpiece of its era, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped on this day in '65. Which track from this iconic album still resonates with you?

events.title: 46 years since we lost John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic loss of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years since his passing. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary innovator, David Bowie.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman Legacy
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of a true icon. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King lives on!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitar maestro and rock legend, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd to the legendary Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs changed music forever. What's your favourite Pagey moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic voice of Rod Stewart, whose career spans decades, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Maggie May Man
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years. What's your favourite Rod tune?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman and British music icon, Suggs (Graham McPherson), celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: It Must Be Love
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to the Nutty Boy himself, Suggs! The voice of Madness, still bringing the house down.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The soulful voice behind hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', Paul Young, celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: 80s Soulman
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to Paul Young! His incredible vocals defined a generation. What's your favourite Paul Young classic?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's Diamond Day
angles.copy: Happy 81st to the incomparable Dolly Parton! A true icon whose music and spirit shine brighter than ever.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Barlow's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From pop anthems to West End hits, he's done it all.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The 'Caribbean Queen' singer, Billy Ocean, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Suddenly It's Billy's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the legendary Billy Ocean! His smooth vocals and infectious grooves are timeless.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame held its very first induction ceremony, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Hall Of Fame History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock history was made with the first Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction. Who's your essential Hall Of Famer?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark's Milestone
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still got that boyband charm.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final live performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockout
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the roof for their last ever live gig. An unforgettable moment in music history!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning artist Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and a stellar solo career, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A true musical powerhouse, from drumming to chart-topping vocals.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's Birthday Groove
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo sensation, his career is truly iconic.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Much-loved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for Only Fools and Horses and A Touch of Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! A true legend of British television. What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since the tragic plane crash that claimed the lives of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering The Legends
angles.copy: On this day in 1959, music lost three incredible talents. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: 80s pop icon and internet sensation, Rick Astley, celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Him Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Still owning the charts and our hearts.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae pioneer and global icon, Bob Marley, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 82nd birthday, we honour the timeless legacy of Bob Marley. His music continues to unite and inspire.
